output.summary: KEP-3156 proposed adding HTTP/3 support to the kube-apiserver (serving on UDP in addition to TCP) and an opt-in HTTP/3 round tripper in client-go. The KEP was deferred until HTTP/3 is supported by the Go standard library.
output.rationale: HTTP/3 was expected to fix head-of-line blocking and speed up connection setup relative to HTTP/2. Reviewers objected that HTTP/3 was still an Internet Draft and that Go's standard library did not support it, so they did not want to plumb a non-stdlib implementation into apiserver and client-go. The KEP was closed and reopened as deferred, with the reason recorded in the document.
output.outcome_reason:
Deferred until HTTP/3 is supported by the Golang standard library. Lavalamp's proposed wording was "we will revisit this when the go standard library supports HTTP/3 or has a very mature candidate."</outcome_reason>
